page: Microsoft Azure D32s_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dsv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical Intel Xeon 8573C cores with hyper-threading. The processor operates at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz and includes a 260 MB L3 cache. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities in memory bandwidth and multi-threaded decompression. Specifically, the large-block uncached memory read and write bandwidths rank in the top 25% of tested systems, reaching 216.15 GB/sec and 92.55 GB/sec respectively. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and Geekbench single- and multi-core scores also place in the top 25%. Image processing performance is highly efficient, scoring in the top 10% tier. For language model workloads, the server achieves top-tier text generation speeds of 403.9 tokens/sec on small 135M models, while maintaining average performance on larger 7B and 70B models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the D32s_v6 offers a balanced resource density suitable for enterprise workloads that require dedicated compute power without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated instances. The lack of bundled local storage means storage costs are decoupled, allowing users to scale Premium Storage independently. This configuration is well-suited for general-purpose applications, static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate-scale LLM inference tasks.
